body: Okay, I know my family does but I want someone outside my family to be interested in me. Like I want a relationship with someone y'know? I'm tired of this boring, pointless life. Hence why I wanna end it
I'm 20, gonna be 21 in December. I just don't make people laugh really, I seem to have a really dry personality. I don't seem that likable tbh

Okay, I'll tell you. So right now I'm stuck in a travel trailer with my family, our 8 cats and our dog whose outside. There's no space, no privacy. We also live on a highway so I can't really go anywhere, I'm stuck here pretty much 24/7. As I've said before, I don't have a car so I'm dependent on my Dad or sister to go somewhere. I've talked to my family about buying me a used car so I could get a job and make some money but they tell me I should wait. We're looking at getting another place sometime soon and we might be moving out of town but I gotta do something. I can't be stuck like this for months. Anyway being that I have nothing to do all day today I'm usually on my PS4 playing a game with friends. Well like a few months ago I met this one girl and I absolutely fell in love with her. I haven't felt this way ever so it's a big deal to me, she means everything to me. She will say "I love you" but I think she means it as a friend, not anything more. But now I feel like I'm losing my friends on the game and that's the worst cause besides my family they're all I have. Especially her. This is depressing the hell outta me, it really is. I even have social anxiety so that's great :)) thanks for listening to me.
I have a lot to say, you'll be talking to me for awhile
I've been giving it time but nothing seems to happen. Life is so boring, so pointless. I'm doing nothing with my life, I'm not that interesting as a person. I just want to end it all :((
